Ari - Sales: OrbitRetail POC hitting sporadic 502/503s during their ramp. Exec demo in 2 hours, they're nervous. Can infra take a look?
Benn (infra): please share request-id + timeframe + model. How many concurrent RPS?
Ari - Sales: request id o-77aa33bb window ~09:42-09:48 UTC, model=rwd-quant-large, client peaked ~140rps with long context.
OpsBot: recent config: model-profile rwd-quant-large kv-cache=max(160MB) set at 09:30 UTC (policy=aggressive-evict).
Carmen (oncall): pulling logs. Can customer replay one failing id with X-Request-ID header for exact correlation?
Ari - Sales: they replayed, pasted tail below.
Ari - Sales: ```
[2026-09-15T09:44:12Z] o-77aa33bb worker=gpupool-11 model=rwd-quant-large error=502 upstream="kv-cache OOM"
[2026-09-15T09:44:12Z] throttled=true queue_len=1342 autoscale_pending=21s
[2026-09-15T09:44:12Z] route_hint=region-us-east required_cap=gpu-A100 available_target=gpupool-burst (gpu-V100) -> incompatible_gpu
```
Benn (infra): ah — looks like two things: 1) kv-cache trimmed down at 09:30 caused higher eviction and OOM on heavy long-context requests, 2) routing attempted burst fallback but target pool has different GPU class (V100) which our runtime marks incompatible for this quantized model, so fallback was skipped. Autoscaler still cold-starting (21s).
Carmen (oncall): can temporarily override compatibility check to allow gpupool-burst (V100) for the POC? That would let them finish the demo.
Benn (infra): we can, but performance may degrade (latency variance). For demo-level headroom it's okay. I'll flip a per-org override for 3 hours and bump kv-cache to 320MB for rwd-quant-large for POC org.
Benn (infra): override applied; kv-cache bumped. :rocket:
Ari - Sales: OrbitRetail re-ran after ~4m -> error rate dropped to ~0.5%, demo resumed. Customer happy. :tada:
Carmen (oncall): root-cause summary for handoff: low kv-cache setting (09:30) + high long-context traffic -> KV OOM; fallback to burst pool skipped due to GPU compatibility rule; autoscaler cold-start lag ~20s.
Benn (infra): short-term mitigations: 1) per-POC kv-cache minimums for long-context/quantized models, 2) allow a compatibility-relax toggle for POC/demo windows, 3) add alert when queue_len>1200 and autoscale_pending>15s.
Ari - Sales: customer asked about guaranteed demo capacity and cost implication. Any quick guidance?
Benn (infra): temporary reserved burst + compatibility override: one-off ~ $100/hr depending on region. Dedicated for sustained need. I'll DM exact quote.
Carmen (oncall): minimal log snippet for the customer report:```
2026-09-15T09:44:12Z o-77aa33bb error=502 "kv-cache OOM"; queue_len=1342; autoscale_pending=21s; fallback_skipped=incompatible_gpu
```
Ari - Sales: sending this to OrbitRetail now. Thanks team :thumbsup:
